description.value: CuppaJoe Coffee Roasters is a Vancouver-area specialty micro-roaster with over 25 years of experience crafting small-batch, hand-roasted coffees using traditional drum roasters and responsibly sourced beans. The Burnaby location at Madison Centre near Brentwood offers a full coffee bar experience with indoor seating. The company operates on third-wave principles — transparency in sourcing and intentional roasting — and supplies cafes and restaurants throughout the Lower Mainland.
